name: Strait of Hormuz Blockade
description: Iran has announced a complete naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz in response to escalating tensions. All commercial shipping through the strait has been halted indefinitely.

emergencyActions: Activate air freight for critical items under 5 tons
Issue emergency RFQs to Indian suppliers (L&T, JSW) for non-critical items
Reroute European shipments via Cape of Good Hope
